newsitem.title: USA: First Oak Brook bank to sell credit card portfolio.
newsitem.headline: First Oak Brook bank to sell credit card portfolio.

text.p: First Oak Brook Bancshares Inc said it expects to record a $5.0 million net gain, after transaction costs and taxes, from the pending sale of the credit card portfolio of its Oak Brook Bank unit.
The credit card portfolio, which remains profitable, was sold to MBNA Corp's MBNA America Bank NA.

"In addition, the company will also share in the future earnings of the credit card portfolio over the next five year period, as defined in the contract," Rose Bbouman, chief financial officer, said in a statement issued Tuesday.
The transaction is expected to close on or before July 1, it added. Exact terms were not disclosed.

"The financial resources freed up and the profits realized from this transaction will be available to support our lending, especially our growing prime indirect auto loan portfolio, and other growth opportunities from branch expansion to acquisitions in banking and allowable non-banking activities," Richard Rieser Jr., president, said in a statement.
